key_idea: For each recipe the number of smoothies is the minimum of have/need over ingredients with need > 0; maximise count times price.
sketch: Read the k stock values, then for each recipe take the floor-division minimum over the ingredients it actually uses, skipping zeros to avoid division by zero, and multiply by the price. O(kr) <= 1e5. The statement guarantees each recipe uses at least one ingredient; values stay under 1e8 but 64-bit is used anyway.
